verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec at docs.mem0.ai/openapi.json and static code snippets in the quickstart, such as client.add(...). Neither shows an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. A machine-readable spec and static snippets are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive explorer the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
